logging_mode.description: Logging mode: 'a' to append, 'l' to replace the log file. Corresponds to -w/--write.

log_file.description: Path to the output log file. Corresponds to -l/--logfile.

socket0.description: Socket number to display in the top view. Corresponds to --socket0.

socket1.description: Socket number to display in the bottom view. Corresponds to --socket1.

nogui.description: Disable the GUI. Useful when only logging is needed. Corresponds to --nogui.
